messages.content: My wife confirmed she has to be back in Atlanta for Monday morning, so Sunday evening is firm. Please narrow this to the Friday flight to Raleigh, a Sunday return, and one hotel room for Friday and Saturday nights. There are two of us.

For November 14-16, the best matched nonstop itinerary is the 7:10 p.m. Friday departure from Atlanta, arriving Raleigh-Durham at 8:35 p.m., with a Sunday return leaving at 7:05 p.m. and arriving in Atlanta at 8:32 p.m. Main Cabin is $234 per person, or $468 total for two. The refundable king room at the Raleigh North Hills Hotel is still available for two nights at $428 including taxes. That combination is $896 altogether.
Is there an earlier Sunday flight that still leaves most of the afternoon open? I do not want to make the family rush through lunch, but I would rather not land too late.

There is a 5:45 p.m. nonstop that reaches Atlanta at 7:12 p.m. It raises the airfare by $36 total, making the flights $504 for two. The next option is the 7:05 p.m. flight at the original $468 total. Both are Main Cabin fares.
Take the 5:45 return. That gives us enough time and gets us home earlier. What seats are open, and is the hotel room definitely one room for both of us?

Yes, the hotel quote is for one king room with two registered adults, checking in Friday and checking out Sunday. On the outbound, adjacent seats 12A and 12B are available. On the return, 14A and 14B are available. Those standard seats do not add a fee. The room remains refundable through 11:59 p.m. local time on November 13.
Use those seats. Before you book, give me the exact combined amount with every tax included and confirm whether either part has a cancellation penalty.

The flights are $504 total for both travelers, including $61.20 in taxes and fees. The two-night hotel is $428 total, including $52.64 in hotel taxes. The combined charge is $932. The airfare is nonrefundable; if canceled before departure, the remaining ticket value can be issued as travel credit under the fare rules. The hotel can be canceled without charge through 11:59 p.m. Raleigh time on November 13. After that deadline, the penalty is one night plus tax.
All right. Book the flights and the hotel. Use our saved traveler profiles, put both of us on the room, and charge the saved Visa ending in 1842.

Before I submit, please confirm that you authorize a total charge of $932 to the Visa ending in 1842: $504 for the two airline tickets and $428 for the hotel. The Friday outbound is at 7:10 p.m., the Sunday return is at 5:45 p.m., and the hotel stay is Friday and Saturday nights in one room for two adults.
Confirmed. Go ahead with the $932 total.

Booked. The round-trip flights for both travelers are confirmed under reference G7K4Q2, with seats 12A and 12B outbound and 14A and 14B returning. The Raleigh North Hills Hotel is confirmed under reservation RNH-583194 for one king room, two adults, checking in Friday, November 14 and checking out Sunday, November 16. The card ending in 1842 was charged $504 for the flights and $428 for the hotel, for a combined total of $932. The hotel remains refundable through 11:59 p.m. Raleigh time on November 13; the airline tickets are nonrefundable and subject to the stated travel-credit rules.
